articles.summary: Players can officially sign at 4 p.m. ET Wednesday. We're following all NFL free agency moves as they happen.

articles.title: Barnwell makes sense of the called-off Crosby trade and the Ravens' Hendrickson signing
articles.summary: Over five days, the Ravens traded for Maxx Crosby, called off the deal and signed Trey Hendrickson.

articles.title: Colts, QB Jones agree to 2-year, $88M contract
articles.summary: The Colts and quarterback Daniel Jones reached agreement Wednesday on a two-year, $88 million contract that can be worth up to $100 million, his agents told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Ravens pivot, agree to add Hendrickson
articles.summary: The Ravens have agreed to sign Trey Hendrickson, sources told ESPN, in a high-priced pivot after their canceled blockbuster trade for Maxx Crosby.

articles.title: Source: Commanders agree with LB Chaisson
articles.summary: The Washington Commanders have agreed to sign K'Lavon Chaisson to a one-year deal, according to NFL Network, adding another edge rusher to their overhauled pass rush.

articles.title: Source: NFL exploring Thanksgiving Eve game
articles.summary: The NFL is exploring the possibility of playing a game the day before Thanksgiving, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Ravens rework Lamar deal for cap space
articles.summary: The Ravens have restructured quarterback Lamar Jackson's contract to create nearly $40 million in salary cap space, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Chargers to re-sign versatile OL Pipkins
articles.summary: The Chargers are bringing back veteran offensive lineman Trey Pipkins III on a two-year, $10 million deal, a source told ESPN on Tuesday.

articles.title: Sources: Pats to release LB Jennings, save $3.8M
articles.summary: The Patriots are set to release OLB Anfernee Jennings, sources tell ESPN, saving the team about $3.8 million against the salary cap.

articles.title: Sources: Jets get their QB, trade for Geno Smith
articles.summary: The Jets are trading for the Raiders' Geno Smith, reuniting the quarterback with the team that drafted him in 2013, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

articles.title: Sources: Steelers keep Heyward on 1-year deal
articles.summary: The Steelers and longtime defensive captain Cameron Heyward agreed to a one-year extension, Heyward's agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Eagles strike, add CB Woolen on one-year deal
articles.summary: Free agent cornerback Riq Woolen reached agreement Tuesday on a one-year deal worth up to $15 million with the Eagles, agent Jason Chayut told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Ricard latest to rejoin Harbaugh in N.Y.
articles.summary: Former Ravens fullback Patrick Ricard agreed to a two-year deal with the Giants, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Pats land Packers' Doubs on 4-year deal
articles.summary: The Patriots have agreed to sign former Packers wide receiver Romeo Doubs to a four-year deal worth up to $80 million, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Saints, LB Elliss reunite on 3-year deal
articles.summary: The Saints have agreed to a three-year, $33 million deal with linebacker Kaden Elliss, according to NFL Network. Originally drafted by New Orleans, Elliss has spent the past three seasons with the Falcons.

articles.title: Source: Commanders add to D with Chenal deal
articles.summary: The Commanders have agreed to a reported three-year, $24.75 million deal with linebacker Leo Chenal.

articles.title: Source: Lions add RB Pacheco to pair with Gibbs
articles.summary: The Lions are signing Isiah Pacheco, giving the team a new running back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Kelce says Swift inspired return for 14th season
articles.summary: Travis Kelce said that fiancée Taylor Swift was a significant influence on his decision to return to the Chiefs for his 14th NFL season.

articles.title: Source: Browns to sign ex-Packers G/C Jenkins
articles.summary: Offensive lineman Elgton Jenkins is signing a two-year deal with the Browns one day after he was released by the Packers, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

articles.title: Snell, FB who helped Jets win SB III, dies at 84
articles.summary: Matt Snell, a three-time Pro Bowl fullback who scored the only touchdown in the Jets' upset of the Colts in Super Bowl III, died of natural causes Tuesday at age 84.
